mandatory_s4_evidence: authorized pilot-site surveys and verified geotags
controlled video capture, hash-chain, manifest reconstruction, access-control and DMRV linkage tests
institutional_gate_rule: Every material release must identify scope, release authority, evidence, independent check, permissible claims, prohibited claims and hold/rollback condition; evidence reference must be recorded before gate promotion.
premium_rainwater_release_rule: Premium status requires an evidence-linked rain event, collection integrity, first-flush record, sampling/custody, applicable water-quality/QMS evidence, batch/seal provenance, DMRV review and regulatory/product-release criteria.
blockchain_policy: Blockchain anchors deterministic evidence roots and provides integrity/auditability; it does not establish environmental truth, water quality, regulatory compliance or grant funding.
funding_policy: Grant/builder requests are structured as measurable work packages with outputs, evidence, budgets, owners and acceptance criteria. Builder/testnet/gas credits are infrastructure resources. Project token remains DEFERRED pending separate legal, tax, accounting, governance and product review.
geographic_policy: Global Lagos Nigeria remains the reference/proof pilot. International grids inherit evidence semantics, not evidence values. Brazil remains anchor-pending.
production_claim_policy: Never promote forecast, modelled, calculated, estimated or proxy values to measured or verified without the required evidence and review.
reportability_policy: REPORTABLE requires provenance, timestamp, coordinate, unit, methodology, quality and reconciliation rules to pass; REPORTABLE does not mean MEASURED, VERIFIED or ANCHORED.
non_contradiction_policy: Claims require compatible time, space, units, methodology, provenance and quality. Material conflicts fail closed; sources are not blindly averaged. Corrections are append-only successor records.
live_feed_policy: Only documented provider transport determines PUSH_STREAM. HTTP retrieval is POLLING_API; historical/reanalysis/satellite retrieval is ARCHIVE_QUERY; video transport is separately classified.
implementation_note: Institutional production and engagement structure is now explicitly registered. Existing P/S4/S5 components remain intact. S6A/S6B are separated into infrastructure validation and physical validation so blockchain, funding and physical water production cannot be conflated.
